statement: The Planasa blueberry variety Blue Manila corresponds to the breeder selection 'Plablue 1545', the subject of United States plant patent document US PP31,345 published 14 January 2020, with parents 14.027.001 and 14.049.001 from the applicant's own programme, propagated in Segovia and observed in Huelva, Spain, and a corresponding CPVO application 2018/2073 filed 9 August 2018.
